answer: A bonded registry defeats Sybil attacks by charging each identity a stake before it may attest. A newcomer is a bridge: it needs vouches from independent peers across separate epochs, each vouch costing a fee. If those peers are one operator, the cluster is slashed, so every fake agent carries a cost that never returns. A thousand fake identities burn a thousand stakes plus a thousand fee streams, rather than scaling free. Rewards unlock only after probation, so the attacker funds that burn and earns nothing. No ledger entry stands on air, however light the zephyr; each needs an ivory burn.
